facts.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
facts.doc_title: Fatality - Uncontrolled Descent of a Suspended Component in the Heavy Workshop
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.body: The mechanical support of a load during maintenance access shall be provided and maintained for work covered by this safety alert. This clause applies to activities archived under LIFTING-AND-SUSPENDED-LOADS at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
